queries.name: All Object Nodes and Edges
queries.description: Retrieves all nodes and edges in the graph
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s)-[]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Object Nodes
queries.description: Retrieves all nodes in the graph
queries.query:
MATCH (s)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN s
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Paths From Secrets
queries.description: Retrieves all paths starting from nodes labeled 'BHK_Secret'
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:BHK_Secret)-[]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' and not s.isTlsSecret=true
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Paths from Pods running as root
queries.description: Retrieves all paths starting from Pods that run as root.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:BHK_Pod)-[]->()
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND s.runAsNonRoot = FALSE AND s.runAsUser = 0
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Paths from Pods running as root, exclude ScheduledOn Edge
queries.description: Retrieves all paths starting from Pods that run as root, excluding scheduling edges.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:BHK_Pod)-[r]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND s.runAsNonRoot = FALSE AND s.runAsUser = 0 AND NOT type(r) = 'BHK_ScheduledOn'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Paths to Nodes with External IPs
queries.description: Retrieves all paths from External to Kubernetes Nodes.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:BHK_External)-[*1..3]->(t:BHK_Node)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Aggregate Nodes
queries.description: Retrieves all paths from nodes that are aggregates of other nodes.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s)-[]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND t.name STARTS WITH 'BHK_ALL'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Paths to AllSecrets
queries.description: Retrieves all paths to the AllSecrets aggregate node.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s)-[]->(t:BHK_AllSecrets)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Paths to AllPods
queries.description: Retrieves all paths to the AllPods aggregate node.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s)-[]->(t:BHK_AllPods)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Pods Sharing Process Namespace
queries.description: Retrieves all pods with shareProcessNamespace enabled.
queries.query:
MATCH (p:BHK_Pod)
WHERE p.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND p.shareProcessNamespace = TRUE
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Full External Attack Paths
queries.description: All paths reachable from the External node up to 6 hops deep.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:BHK_External)-[*1..6]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 500

queries.name: External to Pod via Service
queries.description: Paths where an externally-exposed Service routes to a pod.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:BHK_External)-[:BHK_ExternalRoutesTo]->(svc)-[:BHK_RoutesTo]->(pod:BHK_Pod)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 500

queries.name: All Identity Nodes
queries.description: All principals in the cluster: ServiceAccounts, Users, and Groups.
queries.query:
MATCH (i:BHK_Identity)
WHERE i.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN i
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Impersonation Paths
queries.query:
MATCH p=(src:BHK_Identity)-[:BHK_Impersonate]->(target)
WHERE src.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 500

queries.name: Identity to Secrets
queries.description: Attack paths from any identity to secrets within 4 hops.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(i:BHK_Identity)-[*1..4]->(s:BHK_Secret)
WHERE i.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 500

queries.name: User and Group RBAC Bindings
queries.description: All RoleBound edges originating from Users and Groups.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(principal)-[:BHK_RoleBound]->(role)
WHERE principal.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND (principal:BHK_User OR principal:BHK_Group)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Full Identity Attack Paths
queries.description: Variable-length paths from Users or Groups to critical targets.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(src)-[*1..6]->(target)
WHERE src.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND (src:BHK_User OR src:BHK_Group) AND (target:BHK_Pod OR target:BHK_Secret OR target:BHK_Node)
RETURN p
LIMIT 500
